title: Personal Credit Cards: redemption minimum, point values, redemption ways and forfeiture threshold by tier
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: rewards redemption values and forfeiture threshold

This comparison table covers rewards redemption on the Personal Credit Cards line. For each card tier it gives the smallest redemption, the cash value of one point when redeemed as a statement credit or deposit, the value of one point when redeemed for travel booked through the rewards center, the ways points may be redeemed, and the days past due at which all unredeemed points are forfeited.

## Tier table

| Card tier | Smallest redemption | Cash value of one point | Travel value of one point | Ways points may be redeemed | Days past due at which all points are forfeited |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | none | not applicable |
| College Rewards Visa | 2500 points | 0.01 USD | not applicable | statement credit, deposit to checking, deposit to savings | 60 days |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | none | not applicable |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 2500 points | 0.01 USD | not applicable | statement credit, deposit to checking, deposit to savings | 60 days |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 5000 points | 0.01 USD | 0.0125 USD | statement credit, deposit to checking, deposit to savings, travel booking, gift card | 60 days |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 5000 points | 0.01 USD | 0.015 USD | statement credit, deposit to checking, deposit to savings, travel booking, gift card | 60 days |

## What the columns mean

- **Smallest redemption**: the smallest redemption, in whole points.
- **Cash value of one point**: the USD value of one point redeemed as a statement credit or as a deposit.
- **Travel value of one point**: the USD value of one point redeemed for travel booked through the rewards center.
- **Ways points may be redeemed**: the redemption ways listed for the tier.
- **Forfeiture threshold**: the days past due at which all unredeemed points are forfeited.

## Equivalent reading

- The two tiers without a rewards program, Secured Visa and Platinum Low Rate Visa, list no redemption way and no value.
- Only the points tiers list a travel value and the travel booking and gift card ways.
- The cash value of one point is the same on every tier that has one.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: On a Travel Rewards Visa Signature, what is one point worth as a deposit?**
A: 0.01 USD, the cash value; the travel value of 0.0125 USD belongs to travel booked through the rewards center.
